exercise noun

a piece of schoolwork

also written exercise, correct the exercise

classical

Cic. Off. 1.1.1; Cic. Brut. 97.331: dīcendī (Lewis & Short)
Traupman 29

exercitātiō, exercitātiōnis f.

noun, third declension

practice, an exercise

The classical word for practice of any kind (see practice).

Other words

  • exercitium, exercitiī n. — a (written) exercise

    noun, second declension · also used · post-classical · Tac. A. 2.55 (Lewis & Short); Gell. 3.1.12 (Lewis & Short); Traupman 27, 29; Traupman 311

    Lewis & Short: post-Augustan, not in Cicero or Caesar; Traupman’s word for a written school exercise.

See also practice, homework, exercise book.
